title: 3728. Stable Subarrays With Equal Boundary and Interior Sum

examples.explanation: [9,3,3,3,9] is stable because the first and last elements are both 9, and the sum of the elements strictly between them is 3 + 3 + 3 = 9. [3,3,3] is stable because the first and last elements are both 3, and the sum of the elements strictly between them is 3.
No subarray of length at least 3 has equal first and last elements, so the answer is 0.
[-4,4,0,0,-8,-4] is stable because the first and last elements are both -4, and the sum of the elements strictly between them is 4 + 0 + 0 + (-8) = -4
